userStories.title: rorca-vscode/ Extension Package Scaffold — F5 Runnable Immediately
userStories.description: Create the rorca-vscode/ directory at the repository root with a complete VS Code extension scaffold that activates, connects to the Rorca backend on localhost:3030, renders a SpecTreeDataProvider in the Explorer sidebar (3 group nodes: Pending/Approved/Running, each with child spec nodes showing status icon + story count + readiness %), implements right-click context menu actions (Approve, Trigger Run, Open in Browser, Copy Spec JSON), reads JWT auth from ~/.rorca/credentials with auto-detected server URL fallback, shows a status bar connection indicator, bundles with esbuild, and packages as VSIX via vsce with a GitHub Actions publish workflow on v*-vscode tags. This is the foundation story that MC-004/MC-006/MC-007 in rorca-mcp-cli.json assumed existed (V2-060 was marked passed but produced zero code — no rorca-vscode/ directory exists). The scaffold must be F5-runnable (Extension Development Host launches on F5 with no errors) and include all files needed for VSIX packaging and Marketplace publishing.
acceptanceCriteria: rorca-vscode/ directory exists at repo root with: package.json, src/extension.ts, src/specProvider.ts, src/mcpToolsProvider.ts (stub exporting empty TreeDataProvider), src/auth.ts, tsconfig.json, esbuild.js, .vscodeignore, .vscode/launch.json, .vscode/tasks.json, README.md, CHANGELOG.md, resources/rorca-icon.png (128x128 placeholder PNG), LICENSE — all files present and syntactically valid

package.json has: name='rorca-vscode', displayName='Rorca', publisher='rorca', version='0.1.0', engines.vscode='^1.74.0', main='./dist/extension.js', categories=['Other','Programming Languages'], activationEvents=['onView:rorcaSpecs','onView:rorcaMcpTools','onCommand:rorca.forgeFromSelection'], contributes.viewsContainers.activitybar=[{id:'rorca',title:'Rorca',icon:'resources/rorca-icon.png'}], contributes.views.rorca=[{id:'rorcaSpecs',name:'Specs'},{id:'rorcaMcpTools',name:'MCP Tools'}], contributes.commands registered for rorca.approveSpec/rorca.triggerRun/rorca.openInBrowser/rorca.copySpecJson/rorca.refreshSpecs/rorca.refreshMcpTools/rorca.testConnection/rorca.forgeFromSelection (8 commands total, each with category:'Rorca'), contributes.menus with view/item/context entries for contextValue=='rorcaSpec' showing Approve+TriggerRun+OpenInBrowser+CopySpecJson as inline and context menu items, contributes.configuration with rorca.apiUrl (string, default 'http://localhost:3030', window scope), rorca.defaultWorkspacePath (string, resource scope), rorca.autoRefreshInterval (number, default 60, minimum 0, maximum 3600), rorca.showStatusBarItem (boolean, default true), rorca.insertSyntax (enum ['name-only','json-call','slash-command'], default 'name-only'), contributes.keybindings=[{command:'rorca.forgeFromSelection',key:'ctrl+shift+r',mac:'cmd+shift+r',when:'editorHasSelection && rorca.serverOnline'}]

src/extension.ts exports activate(context: vscode.ExtensionContext) and deactivate() functions; activate() registers SpecTreeDataProvider for 'rorcaSpecs' view, registers McpToolsProvider stub for 'rorcaMcpTools' view, creates status bar item (StatusBarAlignment.Left, priority 100) showing '$(plug) Rorca' with tooltip 'Rorca: Click to test connection', starts 30s health poll interval via GET /api/health using rorca.apiUrl setting, sets context keys 'rorca.extensionActive' and 'rorca.serverOnline' via executeCommand('setContext'), registers all 8 commands, registers onDidChangeConfiguration listener that re-initializes providers when rorca.apiUrl changes; deactivate() disposes status bar item, clears health poll interval, disposes all registered disposables pushed to context.subscriptions — zero memory leaks on reload

src/specProvider.ts exports class SpecTreeDataProvider implementing vscode.TreeDataProvider<SpecTreeItem> with: private _onDidChangeTreeData EventEmitter, readonly onDidChangeTreeData event, getTreeItem(element) returning the element (SpecTreeItem extends vscode.TreeItem), getChildren(element?) that when element is undefined returns 3 group nodes [{label:'Pending',contextValue:'rorcaSpecGroup',collapsibleState:Expanded},{label:'Approved',...Expanded},{label:'Running',...Expanded}] and when element is a group node fetches GET /api/specs?status=<group> from rorca.apiUrl with Bearer token from auth.ts and returns child SpecTreeItem nodes with: label=spec.specName, description=`${passedCount}/${totalCount} stories (${readinessPercent}%)`, iconPath=ThemeIcon('circle-outline') for pending / ThemeIcon('check') for approved / ThemeIcon('play') for running, contextValue='rorcaSpec', tooltip as MarkdownString with spec title + story count + model + generatedAt, command={command:'rorca.openInBrowser',arguments:[specId]} on double-click; refresh() method fires _onDidChangeTreeData; handles ECONNREFUSED by showing single item '$(warning) Server offline' with contextValue='rorcaOffline'; caches last successful fetch for offline display with '(cached)' description suffix

src/auth.ts exports: getAuthToken(): Promise<string|null> that reads ~/.rorca/credentials JSON file (field: token) using fs.promises.readFile with try/catch returning null if file missing; getServerUrl(): string that checks (in order) vscode.workspace.getConfiguration('rorca').get('apiUrl'), then scans workspace folders for CLAUDE.md containing 'rorca' + URL pattern, then falls back to 'http://localhost:3030'; apiFetch(path: string, options?: RequestInit): Promise<Response> that prepends getServerUrl(), adds Authorization: Bearer header from getAuthToken() if token exists, adds Content-Type: application/json, handles 401 by showing vscode.window.showErrorMessage('Rorca: Authentication failed. Check ~/.rorca/credentials') and returning the response (does not throw); isServerOnline(): Promise<boolean> that calls GET /api/health with 5s AbortController timeout returning true on 200, false on any error

rorca.approveSpec command: calls POST /api/specs/:id/approve via apiFetch, shows information message 'Spec approved: <specName>' on success, shows error message on failure, refreshes spec tree; rorca.triggerRun command: calls POST /api/pipeline/trigger with { specPath: 'forge/specs/approved/<specId>.json', workspaceId } via apiFetch, shows information message 'Pipeline started: run #<runId>' on success, handles conflict response (409) by showing 'A run is already active' with 'Queue Next' option; rorca.openInBrowser: opens vscode.Uri.parse(`${serverUrl}/specs/${specId}/review`) in external browser via vscode.env.openExternal; rorca.copySpecJson: fetches GET /api/specs/:id, copies JSON.stringify(specData, null, 2) to clipboard, shows 'Spec JSON copied to clipboard'

tsconfig.json targets ES2020, module commonjs, moduleResolution node, strict true, outDir './dist', rootDir './src', sourceMap true, esModuleInterop true, skipLibCheck true, forceConsistentCasingInFileNames true, lib=['ES2020'], types=['node']; esbuild.js uses the exact VS Code recommended pattern: entryPoints=['src/extension.ts'], bundle=true, format='cjs', platform='node', outfile='dist/extension.js', external=['vscode'], minify in production mode, sourcemap in dev mode, with esbuildProblemMatcherPlugin for VS Code problem matcher integration

package.json scripts: 'compile'='npm run check-types && node esbuild.js', 'check-types'='tsc --noEmit', 'watch'='npm-run-all -p watch:*', 'watch:esbuild'='node esbuild.js --watch', 'watch:tsc'='tsc --noEmit --watch --project tsconfig.json', 'vscode:prepublish'='npm run package', 'package'='npm run check-types && node esbuild.js --production', 'vsce:package'='vsce package --no-dependencies', 'vsce:publish'='vsce publish --no-dependencies'; devDependencies include @types/vscode@^1.74.0, @types/node@^20.0.0, typescript@^5.0.0, esbuild@^0.20.0, npm-run-all@^4.1.5, @vscode/vsce@^3.0.0

.vscodeignore contains: .vscode/**, src/**, node_modules/**, .gitignore, tsconfig.json, esbuild.js, **/*.ts, **/*.map, .eslintrc*, *.vsix — ensures VSIX contains only dist/extension.js, package.json, README.md, CHANGELOG.md, LICENSE, resources/; .vscode/launch.json has 'Run Extension' configuration: type='extensionHost', request='launch', args=['--extensionDevelopmentPath=${workspaceFolder}'], outFiles=['${workspaceFolder}/dist/**/*.js'], preLaunchTask='npm: compile'; .vscode/tasks.json has 'npm: compile' task matching the esbuild problem matcher

GitHub Actions workflow at rorca-vscode/.github/workflows/publish.yml triggers on push tags 'v*-vscode', jobs: build (checkout, setup-node@v4, npm ci, npm run package, upload VSIX artifact), publish (needs build, downloads artifact, uses HaaLeo/publish-vscode-extension@v1 with pat=${{secrets.VSC_MKTP_PAT}} for VS Marketplace and optionally openVsxToken for Open VSX); CHANGELOG.md has ## [Unreleased] and ## [0.1.0] sections with initial release notes; README.md documents: features, installation, configuration settings table, commands table, development setup (npm install, F5 to launch), troubleshooting (server connection, auth)

F5 launch verification: pressing F5 in the rorca-vscode/ directory opens Extension Development Host window, Rorca activity bar icon appears in sidebar, clicking it shows 'Specs' and 'MCP Tools' tree views, Specs view attempts connection to localhost:3030 (shows offline state gracefully if server not running), status bar shows '$(plug) Rorca' item, all 8 commands appear in Command Palette under 'Rorca:' category, no errors in Extension Development Host Debug Console — extension activates cleanly with zero console errors even when backend is offline

src/mcpToolsProvider.ts exports class McpToolsProvider implementing vscode.TreeDataProvider<vscode.TreeItem> with stub getChildren() returning Promise.resolve([]) and getTreeItem(element) returning element — placeholder for MC-004 to fill in; registered in activate() so the MCP Tools view shows empty state without errors

contextUsed.text:
=== GLOBAL STANDARDS (L1) ===
test: true

=== PROJECT CONTEXT (L3) ===
name: rorca
type: web-app
purpose: >-
  AI spec orchestration and pipeline management platform. Converts plain-English briefs
  into structured specs (user stories with acceptance criteria), then executes each story
  as an isolated agent subprocess with full tool access — bash, edit, read, write, glob, grep.
  Tracks progress in real time via SSE/WAL events. Supports three execution engines:
  claude --print (Claude subscription), opencode run (75+ providers), codex (ChatGPT subscription).

stack:
  - React 18
  - TypeScript (strict)
  - Vite 5
  - Tailwind CSS 3
  - xterm.js (@xterm/xterm)
  - react-router-dom v7
  - Express.js
  - PostgreSQL 16 (pg Pool, pgvector, Apache AGE)
  - Node.js >= 20
  - Vitest (frontend tests)
  - Jest (backend tests)
  - Playwright (E2E)
  - Docker Compose

key_modules:
  - src/panels/ — 5 primary panels (SpecsPanel, RunsPanel, AnalyticsPanel, DirectionPanel, SettingsPanel)
  - src/components/ — Shared UI (Shell, Sidebar, RunTerminal, SpecDetailSlideOver, CommandPalette)
  - src/contexts/ — WorkspaceContext, AuthContext, ThemeContext, ToastContext
  - backend/src/routes/ — 32 Express route files (specs, pipeline, workspaces, direction, skills, etc.)
  - backend/src/lib/ — Core services (execution-engine, sse-hub, direction-stack, llm-client, context-router, workspace-echolocation)
  - backend/src/db/ — PostgreSQL Pool, pg-index.ts migration runner, pg-migrations/ (001–049)
  - backend/src/mcp/ — MCP stdio server (5 tools, HTTP transport target)
  - forge/ — run-loop.sh (bash fallback), self-register.ts, spec JSON files
  - packs/ — Convention pack directory (planned)

ports:
  frontend: 5210
  backend: 3030
  finops_sim: 5200

constraints:
  - Backend requires manual restart (no hot-reload via tsx)
  - Auth middleware globally bypassed — local single-user tool
  - WAL wal_events.ts column is ts not created_at
  - spec.id is filename slug — never use specName for paths
  - pg uses numbered placeholders $1/$2 not ?
  - chatComplete returns ChatResult.text — not a plain string

deployment_target: self-hosted (npm run dev locally), Docker Compose, future binary via bun build --compile

integrations:
  - GitHub OAuth + webhooks (partially built)
  - Linear (planned)
  - Vercel (planned)
  - Slack (planned)
  - Claude Code MCP (stdio + HTTP transport)
  - skills.sh registry

=== PROJECT MEMORY (Git History) ===
```yaml
architectural_decisions:
  - description: "Direction stack now 6-layer: L0 (convention packs) → L1 (global eng principles) → L2 (domain) → L3 (project) → L4 (spec brief) → L5 (story annotations). Lower layers override higher (CSS specificity model)."
    evidence: "Convention pack system commit — L0 layer introduced for community-driven conventions below user-defined L1-L5"
  
  - description: "Single execution engine (execution-engine.ts) replaces all bash/TypeScript variants. Supports 3 agent types (claude, opencode, codex) with shared tool set (edit, bash, read, write, glob, grep, webfetch, websearch)."
    evidence: "run-loop.ts (1780 lines) deleted — execution-engine.ts is single source of truth"
  
  - description: "PostgreSQL 16 + pgvector + Apache AGE replaces SQLite. Enables vector search, graph queries, concurrent writes. Port 5433 to avoid user's local Postgres on 5432."
    evidence: "rorca-postgres-migration.json spec created, better-sqlite3 → pg for distribution compatibility (bun build --compile breaks on native addons)"
  
  - description: "Skills are L0 context (below L1-L5 direction stack). LLM matches skills per story during spec generation. No embeddings — single LLM call with skill catalog + MEMORY.md + AGENTS.md + story text outputs relevance scores (1-10) + reasoning."
    evidence: "LLM-driven skill matching commits — piggybacks on spec generation, zero extra API cost. Signal hierarchy: MEMORY.md (strongest) → AGENTS.md → story text → domain L2"
  
  - description: "Skills dual-injected: Claude via .claude/skills/ auto-discovery (native), OpenCode/Codex via buildPrompt() manual injection. Token budgeting through enforceBudget() sorted by LLM relevance score."
    evidence: "react.md + tailwind.md added to both .claude/skills/ and .rorca/skills/ for dual injection"
  
  - description: "Convention packs = frameworks for AI development. Directory structure: packs/<name>/ with direction/, personas/, conventions/, templates/, scaffold/, AGENTS.md. Installed packs populate .rorca/ + direction stack + project scaffold."
    evidence: "Convention pack system + pack_registry table (migration 040) + API routes for install/fork/uninstall"
  
  - description: "Greenfield vs Brownfield onboarding: Greenfield = top-down convention injection from packs. Brownfield = bottom-up convention extraction (agent scans codebase → generates L3 + CLAUDE.md + AGENTS.md → human approval via convention_proposals table)."
    evidence: "Convention inference agent + convention_proposals table (migration 040) for brownfield workflow"
  
  - description: "Agent persona system: Stories support 'persona' + 'reviewers' fields. Personas stored in .rorca/personas/ with 4 categories (_primary/, _adversarial/, _specialist/, _review/). buildPrompt() injects persona markdown before story execution."
    evidence: "15 default personas added (architect, pm, lead-dev, red-team, assumption-buster, devils-advocate, spec-writer, spec-verifier, best-practices, etc.)"
  
  - description: "Multi-pass spec generation pipeline: PM → Spec Writer → UX Designer → Best Practices → Adversarial → Verifier. Each pass refines previous output. Goal: exhaustive specs (every state/edge case/button label explicit, 20-50K words so 'a blind person can implement')."
    evidence: "Multi-pass spec generation commits + spec_versions table for version history per pass"
  
  - description: "Distribution via bun build --compile (standalone binary, no source visible, no runtime dependency). Postgres 16 + pgvector + AGE downloaded on first run to ~/.rorca/postgres/ (Prisma/Playwright pattern). Install: curl -fsSL https://get.rorca.app | sh"
    evidence: "rorca-distribution.json spec created, bin/rorca.ts CLI added with 'rorca start' and 'rorca init'"
  
  - description: "Per-story model override: UserStory interface extended with optional 'model' field. Precedence: story.model > run-level --model > workspace L3 preferred_model > DEFAULT_MODEL. Escalation cascade (Haiku→Sonnet→Opus) still applies on top."
    evidence: "Per-story model routing commit — execution-engine.ts reads story.model before spawning subprocess"
  
  - description: "Skills routed through existing context router (no separate routing block in config.json). Skills are files — micromatch path rules + priority + enforceBudget() applies. Rejected: separate skills routing (duplicates work), bulk install 30+ skills (context pollution), embedding similarity search (replaced by LLM reasoning)."
    evidence: "Skills treated as files commit — context-router.ts unchanged, skills just added to routing table"

bug_patterns:
  - pattern: "Auto-stash runtime files (.rorca/run-state.json, progress.txt, *.jsonl) caused merge conflicts during wave execution."
    example: ".gitignore updated with patterns for run-state.json, progress.txt, *.jsonl, .DS_Store"
  
  - pattern: "Native C++ addons (better-sqlite3) break bun build --compile. Blocked standalone binary distribution."
    example: "PostgreSQL migration prerequisite for distribution — pg is pure JS, works with bun compile"

conventions:
  - rule: "Direction stack precedence: lower layer number overrides higher (L0 < L1 < L2 < L3 < L4 < L5). L0 = convention packs (community defaults), L1-L3 = user-defined, L4-L5 = spec-specific."
  
  - rule: "Persona categories use underscore prefix directories: _primary/, _adversarial/, _specialist/, _review/. Persona files are markdown with YAML frontmatter."
  
  - rule: "Skills dual-saved: .rorca/skills/ (Rorca internal) + .claude/skills/ (Claude CLI auto-discovery). Both copies kept in sync during install/uninstall."
  
  - rule: "Convention packs must have: pack.json (metadata), direction/, personas/, conventions/, templates/, scaffold/, AGENTS.md. Pack loader validates structure before install."
  
  - rule: "LLM skill matching output format: suggestedSkills array per story with { name, relevanceScore (1-10), reason (cites MEMORY.md/AGENTS.md/L2) }."
  
  - rule: "Skill content injection: Claude = noop (auto-discovered), OpenCode/Codex = buildPrompt() reads .rorca/skills/<name>.md + injects into prompt before story execution."
  
  - rule: "Convention proposals (brownfield extraction) stored in convention_proposals table with status: pending/approved/rejected. Human reviews before applying to direction_layers or writing CLAUDE.md."
  
  - rule: "Postgres port 5433 (not 5432) to avoid conflict with user's local Postgres. ~/.rorca/postgres/ for bundled Postgres data directory."
  
  - rule: "Per-story model override precedence: story.model > run --model flag > workspace L3 preferred_model > DEFAULT_MODEL. Escalation (Haiku→Sonnet→Opus) still applies after selection."
  
  - rule: "CLI commands: 'rorca start' (Express + built frontend on :3030), 'rorca init' (bootstrap workspace with .rorca/ directory). bin/rorca.ts is entry point."

avoid:
  - approach: "Separate routing system for skills (dedicated config.json block, heuristic matching, embedding vectors)."
    reason: "Skills are files — context-router.ts already handles micromatch path scoping + priority + token budgeting. LLM matching piggybacks on spec generation (zero extra cost). Embeddings add latency + infrastructure for negligible accuracy gain over LLM reasoning with MEMORY.md context."
  
  - approach: "Bulk install 30+ skills from skills.sh registry on workspace setup."
    reason: "Context pollution. Token waste. Most skills irrelevant to most stories. LLM-driven per-story matching is selective — only injects relevant skills based on story text + MEMORY.md + AGENTS.md."
  
  - approach: "better-sqlite3 for distribution."
    reason: "Native C++ addon breaks bun build --compile. Switched to PostgreSQL (pure JS pg driver) enables standalone binary compilation AND unlocks vectors/graph (pgvector, Apache AGE)."
  
  - approach: "npm publish for distribution (source code visible in node_modules)."
    reason: "Business model requires source protection. Standalone binary via bun build --compile hides source, no runtime dependency. Install script (curl | sh) downloads binary to /usr/local/bin."
  
  - approach: "Auto-commit runtime state files (.rorca/run-state.json, progress.txt)."
    reason: "Causes merge conflicts during wave-based parallel execution (multiple worktrees writing same files). Added .gitignore patterns — runtime state is ephemeral, not source of truth."
  
  - approach: "Multiple execution engine implementations (run-loop.sh bash variant, run-loop.ts TypeScript variant, execution-engine.ts)."
    reason: "Code duplication. Diverging behavior across agents. Consolidated to execution-engine.ts only — single source of truth for claude, opencode, codex. run-loop.sh kept as bash fallback (only used if execution-engine.ts missing)."
  
  - approach: "Auto-promote skills based on effectiveness analytics (auto-install high-performing skills)."
    reason: "Removes user agency. Show effectiveness data in UI (SkillAnalyticsWidget), let user decide. Explicit > implicit for skill adoption."
```

=== SPEC BRIEF (L4) ===
V2-060 in rorca-v2-platform was marked passed but produced no code — no rorca-vscode/ directory exists. Scaffold the VS Code extension from scratch and append stories MC-009 through MC-012 to forge/specs/approved/rorca-mcp-cli.json (currently 8 stories MC-001–MC-008).

   MC-011: JWT auth in src/auth.ts — reads ~/.rorca/credentials, auto-detects server URL from CLAUDE.md, status bar item showing connection state, Bearer token on all fetches, 401 handler
